title: Aggregate tail insights matrix: per-route/model/region p95 & p99 telemetry and regression alerts
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Goal: Add a first-class observability surface that captures p95 and p99 latency per route, model, and region and exposes that data as an interactive matrix/heatmap and a set of regression detectors. This enables faster detection of tail regressions introduced by runtime changes, kernel swaps, or model variants and ties alerts to the relevant route/model/region so SRE/Eng can triage quickly.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: emit per-request latency micro-metrics with tags: route, model, region, zone, instance_type, request_type (sync/stream).
- Aggregation: build a rollup pipeline that computes per-minute and per-hour p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec counters, stored with route/model/region keys.
- Dashboards: a matrix/heatmap explorer where rows are routes, columns are model variants, and cells are colored by p95 / p99 with drilldowns into region and hourly trends.
- Regression detection: automated monitors that compare current p95/p99 to baseline windows using EWMA + non-parametric change tests; thresholding should be configurable per route/model/region.
- Integration: surface alerts into our existing alert routing (Slack / PagerDuty) and link to a pre-populated diagnostic runbook with relevant playback links and regression harness test triggers.
- Backfill: run an offline job to compute 90-day baselines to power anomaly scoring on day one of rollout.

Out of scope for this ticket: per-instance flame graphs and per-token time breakdowns (follow-up work).
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline emits p95 and p99 rollups for all production routes and top 5 model families grouped by region for the last 7 days.
Heatmap dashboard (matrix) exists; users can filter by time window and drill into region and model variant from each cell.
Regression detector runs every 5 minutes and creates actionable alerts with a reproducible diagnostic link when p95 or p99 deviates beyond configurable thresholds.
Backfill job completes and populates baselines for at least 90 days for metrics used by the detector.
Documented runbook and dashboard guide in Confluence with screenshots and escalation steps.
Performance: rollup pipeline adds <10% additional cost to telemetry ingestion and query latency remains interactive (<2s) for typical matrix queries.
implementation_notes: Ingest: extend existing telemetry forwarder to tag requests with model and route metadata; preserve sampling for full-tail computation (sample-rate: 100% for tail computing endpoints).
Rollups: use t-digest / HDR histograms at edge then compute percentiles in the aggregator to avoid raw histogram transfer costs.
Storage: write per-minute keys into the timeseries store (existing metrics cluster) with secondary index by model+route+region for efficient materialized view builds.
Dashboard: build a custom matrix UI in Grafana/EM with backend endpoint to return top-k rows/columns and heatmap buckets; add quick links to trace playback and load test replays.
Detectors: implement two-stage detection: short-term EWMA anomaly score (fast) and periodic non-parametric confirmation (Mann-Whitney U test) before paging.
Canary rollout: start with non-paging alerts for a subset of low-risk routes, validate false-positive rate, then enable paging for high-traffic endpoints.
Backfill: use nightly cluster job that replays compressed histograms over last 90 days to produce baselines; compute diurnal windows for more accurate baselines.
